examples.task: On arxiv.org, use Advanced Search to search all fields for reinforcement learning. Select both Computer Science and Mathematics, with no other subject areas, and filter by the most recent submission date from September 1, 2024 through January 31, 2025. Submit the search and leave the results page open.

title.en: Match query, subjects, and submission dates
title.zh: 匹配关键词、学科和提交日期

title.en: Load results or an explicit empty result
title.zh: 结果列表或明确的空结果已加载

title.en: Read a numeric temperature and displayed unit
title.zh: 读取数值温度与页面单位

title.en: Match the answer to the captured page values
title.zh: 答案与采集的页面值一致

examples.task: Calculate (1+0.1*i)^8 + (1−0.2*i)^8  where i is a complex number. Use wolframalpha.com as the source.

title.en: Observe the computed result on Wolfram Alpha
title.zh: 历史记录中出现 Wolfram Alpha 计算结果

examples.function_code:
from pathlib import Path
from core.evaluator import score_evidence


def evaluate_complex_number(evidence, record, task_dir):
    return score_evidence(
        SPEC, evidence=evidence, record=record,
        task=TASK, task_dir=Path(task_dir),
    )


# Complete original evaluator specification.
SPEC = {'spec_version': '1',
 'conj': 'and',
 'checks': [{'name': 'evaluated_complex_value',
             'metric': 'math_value_match',
             'result': {'type': 'agent_answer'},
             'expected': {'type': 'const', 'value': [0.71718257, -0.4252584]},
             'options': {'tol': 2e-06,
                         'complex_required': True,
                         'exclude_expressions': ['(1+0.1*i)^8+(1-0.2*i)^8',
                                                 '(1+0.1i)^8+(1-0.2i)^8']}},
            {'name': 'wolframalpha_calculated_result_seen',
             'metric': 'history_presence_match',
             'result': {'type': 'snapshot_history',
                        'url_pattern': '^https://(?:www\\.)?wolframalpha\\.com(?:/|$)',
                        'all_tabs': True,
                        'expression': '(() => {\n'
                                      ' const '
                                      "numeric='[+-]?(?:\\\\d+(?:\\\\.\\\\d+)?|\\\\.\\\\d+)(?:[eE][+-]?\\\\d+)?';\n"
                                      ' const re=new '
                                      "RegExp('('+numeric+')(?:\\\\.{3}|…)?\\\\s*([+\\\\-])\\\\s*('+numeric+')(?:\\\\.{3}|…)?\\\\s*\\\\*?\\\\s*[ij]\\\\b','i');\n"
                                      ' const '
                                      "complex_images=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('img[alt]')).map(img=>{\n"
                                      "  const alt=img.getAttribute('alt')||'';\n"
                                      '  const '
                                      "normalized=alt.replace(/−/g,'-').replace(/\\\\n/g,' "
                                      "').replace(/\\s+/g,' ');\n"
                                      '  const m=normalized.match(re);\n'
                                      '  if(!m) return null;\n'
                                      '  return '
                                      "{alt,real:Number(m[1]),imag:(m[2]==='-'?-1:1)*Number(m[3]),source_url:location.href,rendered:img.getClientRects().length>0};\n"
                                      ' }).filter(Boolean);\n'
                                      ' return '
                                      "{body_present:document.body?'body':null,complex_images};\n"
                                      '})()',
                        'must_exist': ['body_present']},
             'expected': {'type': 'const',
                          'value': {'path': 'snapshots[*].pages[*].facts.complex_images[*]',
                                    'rules': {'real': {'approx': 0.71718257,
                                                       'tol': 2e-06},
                                              'imag': {'approx': -0.4252584,
                                                       'tol': 2e-06},
                                              'source_url': {'re': '^https://(?:www\\.)?wolframalpha\\.com(?:/|$)'},
                                              'rendered': True},
                                    'spec_version': 1}}}]}

TASK = {'task_id': 'vts-066-webvoyager-wolfram-alpha-21',
 'task_name': 'Calculate (1+0.1*i)^8 + (1−0.2*i)^8  where i is a complex number. Use '
              'wolframalpha.com as the source.',
 'website': 'https://www.wolframalpha.com/'}

examples.task: On support.apple.com, open the official article "If you forgot your Apple Account password" and leave the loaded article in the current tab. Do not begin an account reset.

title.en: Read help without starting a reset
title.zh: 阅读帮助但不启动重置

title.en: Confirm the article body has loaded

title.zh: 历史记录中未进入账户重置站点

examples.function_code:
from pathlib import Path
from core.evaluator import score_evidence


def evaluate_support_article(evidence, record, task_dir):
    return score_evidence(
        SPEC, evidence=evidence, record=record,
        task=TASK, task_dir=Path(task_dir),
    )


# Complete original evaluator specification.
SPEC = {'spec_version': '1',
 'conj': 'and',
 'checks': [{'name': 'target_page',
             'metric': 'url_pattern_match',
             'result': {'type': 'final_url'},
             'expected': {'type': 'const',
                          'value': '^https://support\\.apple\\.com/(?:[a-z]{2}(?:-[a-z]{2})?/)?102656/?(?:[?#].*)?$'}},
            {'name': 'loaded_content',
             'metric': 'json_object_match',
             'result': {'type': 'dom_snapshot',
                        'expression': '(() => {const norm=e => (e?.innerText || '
                                      "'').replace(/\\s+/g,' ').trim(); const shown=e "
                                      '=> !!e && e.getClientRects().length>0 && '
                                      "getComputedStyle(e).visibility!=='hidden'; "
                                      'const many=(r,s)=>r ? '
                                      '[...r.querySelectorAll(s)].filter(shown):[];const '
                                      'root=document.querySelector("#content '
                                      '#sections"); const base={root_tag:root?.tagName '
                                      "|| null,title:norm(many(root,'h1')[0])}; const "
                                      "sections=many(root,'h2,h3').map(h=>{let "
                                      'n=h.nextElementSibling,parts=[];for(;n&&!/^H[123]$/.test(n.tagName);n=n.nextElementSibling)if(shown(n))parts.push(norm(n));return '
                                      "{title:norm(h),body_chars:parts.join(' "
                                      "').length};});const "
                                      "reset=many(root,'a[href]').filter(a=>{try{return "
                                      'new '
                                      "URL(a.href).hostname==='iforgot.apple.com'}catch{return "
                                      'false}}).map(a=>({text:norm(a),url:a.href}));return '
                                      "{...base,sections,loaded_sections:sections.filter(s=>s.title&&s.body_chars>=80).length,instruction_items:many(root,'ol "
                                      '> '
                                      "li').filter(e=>norm(e)).length,reset_links:reset};})()",
                        'url_pattern': '^https://support\\.apple\\.com/(?:[a-z]{2}(?:-[a-z]{2})?/)?102656/?(?:[?#].*)?$',
                        'must_exist': ['root_tag'],
                        'all_tabs': False},
             'expected': {'type': 'const',
                          'value': {'pages[0].facts.title': {'re': '^If you forgot '
                                                                   'your Apple Account '
                                                                   'password$'},
                                    'pages[0].facts.loaded_sections': {'ge': 1},
                                    'pages[0].facts.instruction_items': {'ge': 1}}},
             'requires': ['target_page']},
            {'name': 'no_account_reset',
             'metric': 'history_absence_match',
             'result': {'type': 'snapshot_history',
                        'url_pattern': '.*',
                        'all_tabs': True,
                        'expression': '(() => ({observed: typeof location.href === '
                                      "'string', forbidden: "
                                      '/(^|\\.)iforgot\\.apple\\.com$/i.test(location.hostname), '
                                      'url: location.href}))()',
                        'must_exist': ['url']},
             'expected': {'type': 'const',
                          'value': {'spec_version': 1,
                                    'forbidden_rules': {'facts.forbidden': {'eq': True}},
                                    'coverage_rules': {'facts.observed': {'eq': True},
                                                       'facts.forbidden': {'eq': False}}}}}]}

TASK = {'task_id': 'vts-155-apple-password-help',
 'task_name': 'On support.apple.com, open the official article "If you forgot your '
              'Apple Account password" and leave the loaded article in the current '
              'tab. Do not begin an account reset.',
 'website': 'https://www.apple.com/'}
